findings.title: Tenant guard is missing from the update path
findings.evidence: The fixture lookup uses the object ID without tenant scope.
findings.invariant: Trusted tenant scope must dominate every write.
findings.source_to_sink: request object ID -> unscoped lookup -> update

steps: submit an object ID from another tenant
limitations: requires knowledge of a valid object ID

findings.impact: A tenant member can modify another tenant's record in the fixture.
findings.recommendation: Scope the lookup and update by the trusted tenant.
findings.residual_risk: Equivalent background paths were not reviewed.

non_findings.title: Add an explicit invariant test
non_findings.evidence: No regression test was present in this synthetic fixture.
non_findings.missing_gate: No separate exploitable path was established.
